host.power_posture: shared host; no affinity or power isolation; schedutil observed later, not sampled at both benchmark starts

benchmark.notes: Go caps the enum parser at 1e9 iterations before 30s; this row is informative only. Wall duration includes calibration/setup/compilation. Ratios to per-case flag exceeding 10 are reported, not hidden.

fuzz.notes: 21x original target multiplier explicitly exceeds the protocol 10x visibility threshold. Six low-progress campaigns repeated with explicitly bounded minimization: 27 campaigns total, 810 nominal seconds, 27x the per-target flag. Targets are serial; workers run within one target.

ordinary_tests.cache: test result cache disabled by -count=1; compiler cache retained

budget.retries: No benchmark repetitions. Six explicitly recorded supplemental fuzz campaigns bound minimization after low original execution counts. Development test/analyzer retries are all retained and classified.

benchmarks.comparison: One observation per workload per revision; no statistical latency trend. Harness parent allocation reporting and embedded setup changed; timed operations and fixture bytes did not.
